query: Processing under the authority of the controller or processor
response:
Based on the provided context from Article 28 (Processor) and Article 29 (Processing under the authority of the controller or processor), I can answer your question as follows:

The processor and any person acting under the authority of the controller or of the processor, who has access to personal data, shall not process those data except on instructions from the controller, unless required to do so by Union or Member State law.

In simpler terms, a processor (or any person authorized by them) can only process personal data at the instruction of the controller, unless there is a requirement under EU or national law that requires otherwise.
